why: Ten automations V01D runs every hour on its own engine (lib/automations.js, the 15-minute clock in void-tick.yml). Owner, 2026-10-14: "make sure V01D has 10 new automations hourly so that it starts to really utilize all it can to progress". Five guards say the hour something breaks, two signals say when something moves, three engines keep one job each in the build queue. Created through POST /api/automations by tools/automations-seed.mjs (.github/workflows/automations-seed.yml); the same id replaces a rule, so seeding twice changes nothing.
